name: Girlfriend
source:
In this immersive game, you'll step into the shoes of a young software engineer working at a computer company.

After three years of engagement, you make the big decision to move in with your fiancée.
The story unfolds from the moment you introduce the house to your future in-laws.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
在这款身临其境的游戏中，你将扮演一名在计算机公司工作的年轻软件工程师。

订婚三年后，你做出重大决定，搬去与未婚妻同住。
故事从你将房子介绍给未来姻亲的那一刻起展开。

[来自F95Zone]
